# === freeze/2 ===

--8<-- [start:freeze_2]
freeze(X, Goal)
--8<-- [end:freeze_2]

--8<-- [start:freeze_2_ex2]
# Guard: X must be positive when bound
Guarded(X) <- (
    freeze(X, X > 0),
    X is 5
)
# succeeds — 5 > 0

Rejected(X) <- (
    freeze(X, X > 0),
    X is -1
)
# fails — the unification X = -1 is rejected because -1 > 0 fails
--8<-- [end:freeze_2_ex2]

--8<-- [start:freeze_2_ex3]
# Deferred binding
Deferred(Y) <- (
    freeze(X, Y is X),
    X is "hello"
)
# Y = "hello" — the frozen goal Y is X fires when X is bound

# Multiple freezes on the same variable
Multi(Y, Z) <- (
    freeze(X, Y is X),
    freeze(X, Z is X),
    X is 42
)
# Y = 42, Z = 42
--8<-- [end:freeze_2_ex3]


# === when/2 ===

--8<-- [start:when_2]
when(Condition, Goal)
--8<-- [end:when_2]


# === setup_call_cleanup/3 ===

--8<-- [start:setup_call_cleanup_3]
setup_call_cleanup(Setup, Call, Cleanup)

# === call_cleanup/2 ===

--8<-- [start:call_cleanup_2]
call_cleanup(Call, Cleanup)
--8<-- [end:call_cleanup_2]

--8<-- [start:call_cleanup_2_ex2]
SafeQuery(GOAL) <- call_cleanup(
    call_goal(GOAL),
    writeln_text("query finished")
)
--8<-- [end:call_cleanup_2_ex2]
